headline: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon
title: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon. What is it? It is a Level twelve LIGHT Dragon Fusion Monster with four thousand five hundred attack. What does it do? It is made from three Blue-Eyes White Dragons fused together, and it has no extra effect. How do you use it? You need three Blue-Eyes White Dragon plus a fusion card like Polymerization. It appears in Duelist Pack: Kaiba. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
